description: Read a public profile on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, GitHub or a website. A `found` answer includes the profile, recent posts and platform details when available: account ids, links, creation dates and public counts. Instagram's `userId` and `graphId` name different ids; neither grants permission. Missing fields are null; unsupported blocks are absent. Data outcomes answer 200: `found`, `notFound` (confirmed by the platform, cached an hour) or `undecided` (refunded, never cached). 1 credit on a miss, 0 on a hit. `extractedAt` is the original read time, including cache and snapshot hits.

input.description: A profile URL, post URL, website or @handle.

platform.description: Required when `input` is a bare handle.

posts.description: Recent posts to return (0–15). Default 10. This limits the answer, not the source read.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and the snapshot; costs a credit even when fresh.

name: lookup_profile
title: Look up a public profile
